exposure: timing and setting of red cell transfusion (operating theatre, within 12h of delivery, prescribed by anaesthetists)
cohort: The study included 3235 women who delivered in 2013 at a tertiary level obstetrics unit, of whom 110 received a postpartum red cell transfusion.
finding: A significant number of postpartum red cell transfusions were inconsistent with new guidelines, indicating opportunities to improve antenatal red cell mass management and transfusion practices.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for events occurring in 2013.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight was identified as being associated with transfusion.
